reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul) to ~1200+/month (Aug-Sep) (E-02), driven by a defect introduced around August in the billing import + validation step of meter-to-cash, which produces incorrect bills predominantly for accounts with ACTUAL (not estimated) meter reads (E-03: 59% actual vs 41% estimated among disputed bills). This is not explained by slow ticket handling, which remains within SLA (E-01), nor by a tariff change, which the log shows did not occur (E-04/E-05), nor primarily by estimate substitution from field/AMI read failures, since actual-read bills dominate the dispute population (E-03).
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul) to ~1200+/month (Aug-Sep) (E-02), driven by a defect introduced around August in the billing import + validation step of meter-to-cash, which produces incorrect bills predominantly for accounts with ACTUAL (not estimated) meter reads (E-03: 59% actual vs 41% estimated among disputed bills). This is not explained by slow ticket handling, which remains within SLA (E-01), nor by a tariff change, which the log shows did not occur (E-04/E-05), nor primarily by estimate substitution from field/AMI read failures, since actual-read bills dominate the dispute population (E-03).
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
